transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because I keep forgetting things that I really shouldn't. It's... it's just becoming an issue. 

Like, I'll completely forget about my heart follow-up appointments, or I'll forget to call the clinic back when I'm supposed to. Even just regular stuff—I'll go to do a repair job around the house and realize I showed up without the right tools. I just need to figure out what's going on.
Have you been feeling particularly sad, hopeless, or anxious lately?

No, not really. I mean, I get a bit frustrated with myself when I mess up, but... no, I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. And I'm not really an anxious guy either. My mood is generally fine, it's just this forgetting stuff that's bothering me.
Have you noticed any difficulty with other things, like finding the right words when you speak, or perhaps getting confused about where you are or what time of day it is?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't have any trouble finding words when I'm talking. And I definitely know where I am and what day it is, nothing like that. It's really just... well, just the forgetting to do things, like the appointments and bringing the right tools. But my mind feels perfectly clear otherwise.
Do you have any current or past medical conditions, such as heart disease, diabetes, or any recent head injuries?

Well, just the heart issue that I have those follow-ups for. But other than that, no. No diabetes, and I haven't hit my head or had any recent injuries or anything like that. Physically, I'm doing pretty alright.
Do you consume alcohol, and if so, how much would you say you drink on a typical day?
No, I don't drink. None at all, actually. On a typical day, it's just coffee or water for me. I mean, I've just never been much of a drinker, so yeah, zero.
Have you struggled with this level of forgetfulness your entire life, or is this a recent change for you?

You know, I'm honestly not sure. I haven't really... I haven't kept track of it like that. It's hard to say if it's been my whole life or if it's just a recent thing. I just know it's what I'm dealing with right now, but I couldn't really give you a timeline on it.
Looking back at your time in school, did you frequently struggle with staying focused on your assignments, losing your belongings, or getting distracted during class?

Yeah, I definitely did. Even way back as a boy in grade school, I was the kid who just couldn't stay in his seat. I'd... I'd always blurt out answers before the teacher was even done asking, and I constantly got notes sent home to my parents for talking too much. So, yes, I definitely struggled with that kind of stuff back then.
